correctness.rationale: Four pair orbits exhaust the complete two-leader domain. Direct block inversion yields exact cost functions. The positive difference J_zz-J_uv excludes both leaves for all m>=4. Threshold comparisons and the negative expression for P(c_star) rule out the weaker hub and give all strict and tie cases. The quadratic discriminant proves the m>=7 wedge. The standalone exact-rational verifier passes 5,814 matrix inverse comparisons and 157 complete optimizer checks. Finitary checks are supplementary to algebraic proof.
